{{Quote|Commander, They've destroyed the ''Orion''.|Rebel officer to Commander Jun Sato|<ref name="Zero Hour" />}}
The '''''Orion''''' was a [[Braha'tok-class gunship|''Braha'tok''-class gunship]] that was in service of the [[Massassi Group]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] cell led by [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]]. In [[2 BBY]], it traveled to [[Atollon]] with a portion of the cell to meet with [[Phoenix Cell]], which had a [[Chopper Base|base]] on the [[planet]], to launch an attack on [[Lothal]]s [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] factories. But as they were preparing to launch the assault, [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] [[Battle of Atollon|ambushed]] the two cells and as they attempted to break the blockade, the ''Orion'' was destroyed.

==Description==
The Orion was a [[Braha'tok-class gunship|''Braha'tok''-class gunship]]<ref name="Zero Hour" /> that was 90 [[meter]]s in length and could have a crew of 75 personnel. The [[gunship]] had a complement of 8 [[turbolaser]] [[cannon]]s and 8 [[concussion missile launcher]]s.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> The ''Orion'' was built with a silver plated hull to deflect solar radiation and had its command [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] at the bow and its class 1 [[hyperdrive]] at the rear of the ship.<ref name="Starfighters" />

==History==
[[File:Zero_Hour_thumb.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Orion'' and two other ''Braha'tok''-class gunships during the battle of Atollon]]
The ''Orion'' became a part of the [[Massassi Group]], a rebel cell in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] led by [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]]. Following the [[Declaration of Rebellion|formation]] of the Alliance, the ''Orion'', two other ''Braha'tok''-class gunships and a portion of Dodonna's fleet went to [[Atollon]] where the [[Phoenix Cell]] was [[Chopper Base|based]]. The combined fleet was preparing for an [[attack on Lothal]]'s [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] factories but were discovered by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]], whose [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|forces]] [[blockade]]d the [[planet]]. [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]] led the [[Battle of Atollon|attacks]] on the blockade from his [[flagship]], the ''[[Phoenix Nest]]'', as an attempt to break it. However the attacks were ultimately worthless costing the rebels too many [[starfighter]]s and [[starship]]s.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

With his tactic becoming too costly, Sato ordered the fleet to charge the blockade. The ''Orion'' and many other ships advanced on the blockade only for one of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] to destroy a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate|Nebulon-B frigate]]. [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] then flew on an attack vector to the ''Orion'' and dealt two crippling blows to the gunship's underbelly on the attack run. The ''Orion'' continued moving forward but the damage caused it's bow to explode, beheading the starship. Sato witnessed the ''Orion's'' demise from his ship and a reported to him over the comm that it had been destroyed.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Orion'' first appeared in the [[Star Wars Rebels]] [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|Season Three]] finale "[[Zero Hour]]."<ref name="Zero Hour" />
